_note: PLACEHOLDER — the v0 itemization spine. Two curios drop unidentified and identify at the Storehouse: one into a consumable, one into a key. The key opens a locked cache in a DIFFERENT world than the one it dropped in (design-brief-v0, delayed-payoff seed).

items.name: Humming Shard
items.blurb: It hums when you are not listening.

items.name: Bound Knot
items.blurb: Tied by someone who meant it to stay tied.

items.name: Lesser Salve
items.blurb: Restores a little health to one party member.

items.name: Cache Key
items.blurb: Fits a lock in a world that is not this one.

items.name: Chipped Blade
items.blurb: Somebody's, once. It still holds an edge on one side.

items.name: Keen Blade
items.blurb: Balanced, and cared for. Whoever left it did not mean to.

items.name: Binder's Edge
items.blurb: Marked along the spine in a hand you almost recognise.

items.name: Padded Guard
items.blurb: Layered cloth and patience. Better than nothing, which is what you had.

items.name: Banded Guard
items.blurb: Someone spent a winter on this.

items.name: Vaultplate
items.blurb: Cold to the touch, and stays cold.
